overview_description.description: CertiK is a pioneer in blockchain security, leveraging best-in-class AI technology to protect and monitor blockchain protocols and smart contracts. Founded in 2018 by professors from Yale University and Columbia University, CertiK’s mission is to secure the web3 world. CertiK applies cutting-edge innovations from academia to enterprise, enabling mission-critical applications to scale with safety and correctness.

product.name: Formal Verification
product.description: A mathematical verification service that proves specified security and correctness properties of smart contracts, blockchain protocols, and critical systems.
